M-VIEW-WIDGET.Purpose: Decorated layout container with externally supplied children and optional native invisible-button activation.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: View visual surface: background color/image, image scaling/position/tint, independent borders/radii and BoxShadow.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: View Tooltip, Disabled and OnClick Props; children returned by BuildRenderTree.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Child clipping and transform geometry — owned by M-WIDGET and M-CLIP-SERVICE.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Shared painting algorithms — owned by M-APPEARANCE-DRAWERS.

Requirements.REQ-001: View owns only its own appearance and relies on WidgetRenderer for children; decoration does not change layout or clip descendants.
Requirements.REQ-002: OnGUI delegates surface, outer shadow, border and optional background image to appearance drawers.
Requirements.REQ-003: When enabled and OnClick is present, native Widgets.ButtonInvisible may invoke that action; Disabled prevents activation.

Inputs.IN-001: Calculated Rect, visual Props, Tooltip and child WidgetList.

Outputs.OUT-001: Decorated native IMGUI container with its declarative children.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Native drawing and optional OnClick action on activation.
